topic: You share 60% of your DNA with a banana — and scientists can prove it
hook: You share 60% of your DNA with a banana.
script: You share 60% of your DNA with a banana. Humans and bananas share 60% of their genetic code. We share 85% with mice. 96% with chimpanzees. 31% with yeast. Every living thing on Earth shares DNA because all life descended from the same common ancestor. We are all, at a fundamental level, cousins. Follow for biology facts that make the world feel beautifully connected.
